prompt: A young Chinese woman with elegant East Asian features, quietly leaning against a rough textured old white wall of a traditional Tibetan style rural building. Calm, restrained expression, gazing into the distance, conveying a cool, natural, understated mood. Long black hair in two low braids falling in front of her chest, with loose wisps framing her face. Soft refined facial features, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup. Wearing an oversized oatmeal beige cashmere knit sweater with slightly gathered sleeves, paired with loose dark brown long skirt or wide leg trousers in muted earthy natural fabrics. Small turquoise earrings and subtle ethnic beaded bracelet. Background: rough white rammed earth Tibetan wall, weathered dark wooden window/door frames, faint carved geometric patterns, low key dark red or earthy brown trim. Stone or rough paved ground. Soft warm natural daylight, low saturation palette: beige, oatmeal, dark brown, off white, weathered wood, muted red and turquoise accents. Subtle film grain, realistic textures, poetic negative space. Documentary/editorial portrait, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, background recognizable. Medium to full body, vertical composition, subject slightly right of center.
